title: krn lane start admits parallel lanes on one task the lead already claimed
body:
Why: lanes refactor-successor and refactor-misc for t-5wzk8zf found `krn lane start` refusing because lane refactor-context held the claim, and created worktrees by hand with git worktree add (skipping fetch/claim bookkeeping).
Outcome: `krn lane start <slug> --task <id>` admits a further lane on a task the same lead already claimed (shared claim, distinct slug/worktree), or prints the exact command to proceed.
Proof: a task test starts two lanes on one claimed task; both worktrees exist and the claim stays held once.
